text:
marta: Heads-up — hotfix PR #11024 (kv-cache mem spike) needs 2x LGTM before the 23:00 UTC cutoff. I can't hold the window without a second approver.

dan: On it, can someone from SRE give an eyeball for the rollback hooks? I won't be online at 23.

jen: I can take a look in 10m, will focus on the smoke tests and the migration guard.

liam: pinging @sre-oncall — do we have capacity for a quick review? If SRE signs off we can merge and trigger canary.

sre-oncall: Ack, I'll run through the probe logs and validate the backoff config. Give me ~8 minutes.

marta: Thanks — note: deploy pipeline requires the second approver to be a repo owner or delegated shadow. If neither shows, we need explicit opt-in from @jen or @liam as shadow.

jen: I can be shadow for this one. I reviewed the diff earlier; main concern is the KV warmup flag timing. I left a small comment on the PR.

liam: I left one minor nit about a log line, non-blocking. LGTM from me after that is addressed.

deploy-bot: [auto] PR #11024 status: CI passed · mergeable · awaiting required approvals (1/2).

sre-oncall: SRE checks done: probe OK on canary config, rollback test passed locally. LGTM from SRE. :white_check_mark:

marta: Perfect — that's 2x. @deploy-bot can you proceed with the staged merge?

deploy-bot: [auto] Merge scheduled at 22:58 UTC, canary deploy will run for 10m, rollback window 23:10 UTC. Watch logs: https://ci.redwood/internal/builds/11024

anya: leaving a note: if canary shows memory regrowth > 5% we'll autobackout. Anyone on watch for 23:05-23:20?

jen: I'll be monitoring the canary channel and can trigger rollback if needed.

liam: If anything weird, tag me and I'll reroute traffic.

marta: Thanks team — closing loop. If we hit an issue we'll follow the incident runbook. :thumbsup:
